Definition
[$\sigma $-algebra] 1. appE:E.1-def-1\group Measure Theory A collection $\mathcal M$ of subsets of $\mathbb R^n$ is a $\sigma $-algebra if:

(i) $\emptyset ,\mathbb R^n\in \mathcal M$;

(ii) $A\in \mathcal M$ implies $\mathbb R^n-A\in \mathcal M$;

(iii) whenever $\{ A_k\} _{k=1}^\infty \subset \mathcal M$, both $\bigcup _{k=1}^\infty A_k$ and $\bigcap _{k=1}^\infty A_k$ belong to $\mathcal M$.
